messages:
maria: Heads-up — during the last APAC dedicated pool rotation we saw 95th latency jump ~120ms for a few tenants. looks like egress queueing + one noisy tenant hitting nvlink bursts.
ajay: saw it too. Grafana: https://graf.company/g/apac/dedicated-egress — spikes at 11:02-11:06. CPU on proxy side stayed normal, GPU KV hit + pending egress packets.
nicole: cost question — if we start pinning egress to quieter racks, are we blowing up cross-az egress bills?
maria: short answer: maybe. longer: hedging with latency-first routing could steer high-SLA tenants to pinned racks and overflow others to best-effort. tradeoff = reserved headroom cost vs SLA violations.
leo: can we do a temporary soft-pin: prefer quiet subnets but allow fallback after 200ms tail? avoids hard carveouts.
ajay: prototype config I used in canary (snippet):
```
routing: 
  policy: latency_hedge
  prefer_subnets: [apac-p1, apac-p2]
  fallback_after_ms: 200
  tenant_tags: [sla_premium]
```
ajay: results from 30m canary: premium tenants 95th down 80ms, non-premium 95th up 20ms. no cross-region egress increase observed in 30m window.
nicole: 30m might hide bursty billing. need 24h estimate. also watch local fanouts — some racks degrade NIC queues when pinned.
maria: agreed. proposal: 1) run 24h canary with telemetry on p99/p95 and egress bytes, 2) add egress budget cap per-tenant to auto-fallback, 3) add a cheap detector for nvlink bursts to avoid pinning to noisy host.
infra-bot: alert: dedicated-pool/apac/p1 nvlink_burst_detected count=3 in last 15m — hosts flagged [apac-p1-23, apac-p1-47].
leo: add host-level avoidance: mark hosts with nvlink_burst_detected for 10m in scheduler weight calc. simple and quick.
ajay: thinking ahead — could also do adaptive quantized-fallback for tenants during egress pressure: smaller variant uses less PCIe bandwidth. reduces noisy neighbor impact but impacts quality.
nicole: that could be a good knob if product ok with quality vs latency/cost. need product sign-off.
maria: next steps: ajay run 24h hedging canary with budget caps + host avoidance, leo add nvlink flag to scheduler, nicole take cost projection and product comms. ping me with results. :thumbsup:
leo: on it.
ajay: starting canary now (command):
```
./deploy_canary --policy latency_hedge --region apac --duration 24h --metrics-tag hedging-test-2026-03-21
```
ajay: will post back a short summary at end of run.
maria: thanks — keeping this thread for the post-mortem notes and cost numbers.
